reason: Classified as a memory-context plugin because its core user-facing function is managing and compressing session context by pruning large tool outputs while retaining recovery paths via search/recall. It is implemented as a DeepSeek Harness bundle with a Cordis patch and peer dependencies for compaction tools, with no evidence of external service orchestration or unrelated domain features.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在会话中对大型工具输出进行裁剪并生成预览，以控制上下文体积并支持更精确的检索与恢复流程。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that trims large tool outputs into compact previews to control session context size while supporting targeted search/recall-based recovery.

capabilities: Prunes oversized tool-call outputs into compact previews before the next model step
Preserves full tool output in session history while limiting immediate context usage
Configures recall/search-oriented recovery behavior for long-session context handling
